fib: ______ is a subset of the total market demand.
Project demand
Project demand is a subset of the total market demand.
______ are the total value of goods or service sold to third parties.
Total sales
Total sales are the total value of goods or service sold to third parties.
______ is the starting point of our discussions concerning the project and the external environment which is the market.
Demand analysis
Demand analysis is the starting point of our discussions concerning the project and the external environment which is the market.
______ refer to sales for which payment is not made immediately.
Credit sales
Credit sales refer to sales for which payment is not made immediately.
______ are the obligations which are payable in a period of time greater than a year.
Long Term Liabilities Long-term liabilities
Long Term Liabilities Long-term liabilities are the obligations which are payable in a period of time greater than a year.
______ is an important aspect of our study of project evaluation.
Project cost analysis
Project cost analysis is an important aspect of our study of project evaluation.
______ is the first stage of a project cycle.
project idea stage
The Project Idea Stage The project idea stage is the first stage of a project cycle.
______ is the difference between the present worth of benefits and the present worth of costs.
net present worth
The net present worth is the difference between the present worth of benefits and the present worth of costs.
______ is an important ratio as it expresses the relationship between cash generated from operations and sales.
Cash Flow Margin ratio
The Cash Flow Margin ratio is an important ratio as it expresses the relationship between cash generated from operations and sales.
______ are the difference between total sales revenue and credit sales.
Cash sales
Cash sales are the difference between total sales revenue and credit sales.
______ is a statement that shows the actual receipt of cash (inflows) and the disbursement of cash (out flows) of a firm or project.
cash flow statement
A cash flow statement is a statement that shows the actual receipt of cash (inflows) and the disbursement of cash (out flows) of a firm or project.
______ is an important profitability ratio because it measures the efficiency with which the company is managing its investment in assets and using them to generate profit.
Return on Assets ratio
The Return on Assets ratio is an important profitability ratio because it measures the efficiency with which the company is managing its investment in assets and using them to generate profit.
______ refers to the real output that a plant can achieve given the market situation.
Actual capacity
Actual Capacity Actual capacity refers to the real output that a plant can achieve given the market situation.
______ are the firm's short term investment in shares, bonds and other securities.
Marketable securities
Marketable securities are the firm's short term investment in shares, bonds and other securities.
______ is a group of related projects designed to accomplish a common goal over an extended period of time.
programme
A programme is a group of related projects designed to accomplish a common goal over an extended period of time.
______ is a function of future cash flows.
Ability to service debts
Ability to service debts is a function of future cash flows.
